likeness_rule: Invented face. Never the likeness of any real person or family member. An age or costume change is an edit of the reference portrait, never a new face; a new century gets new people (descendants or newcomers), never the same faces.

voice.design_prompt: A Welsh woman in her late thirties from the Vale of Glamorgan, warm, low, steady voice with a gentle South Wales lilt, plain-spoken farm woman, natural and unhurried.
voice.accent_notes: Welsh characters speak with a thick South Wales (Glamorgan) accent in every language; non-Welsh characters keep their own accents. Welsh fallback for a line that fails transcribe-back: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS voice Kore (timbre changes).
